description: The DRM technology system used to enforce license-based playback protection. 'Widevine' = Google/Android/Chrome; 'PlayReady' = Microsoft/Xbox; 'FairPlay' = Apple/iOS/tvOS; 'multi_drm' = simultaneous multi-system packaging for cross-platform OTT distribution.

reference: Dalet Galaxy DAM Policy Lifecycle Management; Rights Agreement Expiry Standards

description: Cryptographic encryption standard applied to content packages under this DRM policy. 'CENC' (Common Encryption) and 'CBCS' are ISO 23001-7 standards used for multi-DRM packaging across Widevine, PlayReady, and FairPlay systems. Governs how content is encrypted at the CDN packaging layer.
reference: ISO 23001-7 Common Encryption (CENC); W3C Encrypted Media Extensions (EME); DRM Industry Forum (DRMIF)

description: Indicates whether geographic access restrictions are enforced under this DRM policy. description: Maximum duration in seconds for which a DRM license issued under this policy remains valid for playback. Controls license renewal frequency and session persistence. A value of 0 indicates a persistent license with no expiry. Critical for PPV and live event access control.

description: Defines the license persistence and renewal behavior for content playback under this DRM policy. 'persistent' = license stored on device across sessions; 'session' = license valid only for current playback session; 'renewable' = license auto-renews before expiry; 'non_renewable' = single-use license.
reference: W3C Encrypted Media Extensions (EME); Widevine License Server Specification; PlayReady License Chaining

description: Maximum video resolution permitted for playback under this DRM policy. Enforces resolution caps based on subscription tier and device security level.
reference: Widevine Security Level L1/L3 Resolution Caps; PlayReady Security Level Resolution Enforcement

description: Indicates whether this DRM policy permits subscribers to download content for offline playback on authorized devices. When True, offline_download_expiry_hours governs the download window. Governed by rights agreements and CBA terms for league content.

description: Number of hours after which an offline downloaded content license expires and the content becomes unplayable without re-authentication. Null when offline_download_enabled is False. Enforces time-limited offline access per rights agreements.

description: Hardware output protection standard required on playback devices under this DRM policy. 'hdcp_1x' / 'hdcp_2x' = High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection for HDMI/DisplayPort; 'cgms_a' = Copy Generation Management System for analog outputs; 'macrovision' = legacy analog copy protection. reference: HDCP Specification (Digital Content Protection LLC); CGMS-A Standard; PlayReady Output Protection Levels

description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the jurisdiction (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, DEU). Supports multi-national operations across FIFA, UEFA, and global league markets.

description: Name of the county or parish within the state/province, where applicable. Relevant for county-level sales tax and entertainment tax jurisdictions (e.g., Los Angeles County, Cook County).

description: The county-level component of the combined tax rate, expressed as a percentage. Null when no county-level tax applies. Used for accurate tax remittance to county taxing authorities.
reference: AICPA State & Local Tax Standards; Multistate Tax Commission (MTC)

description: Timestamp when this tax jurisdiction record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports SOX audit trail requirements for financial master data.

description: Date from which this tax jurisdiction record and its associated rates become effective. Supports temporal versioning of tax rates as jurisdictions change rates over time. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

description: Date on which this tax jurisdiction record and its associated rates expire or are superseded. Null indicates the record is currently active with no known end date. Supports historical rate lookups for amended tax filings.

description: Specific entertainment or amusement tax rate levied on live event admissions, PPV (Pay-Per-View) transactions, and concert ticket sales. Separate from general sales tax. Applicable in jurisdictions such as Chicago (amusement tax) and New York City.

description: Day of the month (1–31) by which the tax return and remittance must be submitted to the taxing authority following the close of the filing period. Used to drive automated tax calendar alerts in SAP S/4HANA FI.

description: Annual interest rate applied to unpaid or underpaid tax balances in this jurisdiction. Used in tax liability accrual calculations and EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization) impact modeling.

description: Non-resident income tax rate applied to athlete compensation earned while performing in this jurisdiction. Calculated based on duty days or games played in the jurisdiction. description: Classification of the tax jurisdiction level within the governmental hierarchy. description: Minimum revenue threshold (in jurisdiction currency) above which Sports Entertainment establishes economic nexus and becomes obligated to collect and remit sales or entertainment tax in this jurisdiction. Post-South Dakota v. Wayfair (2018) economic nexus standard.

description: Required or preferred method for remitting tax payments to the taxing authority. reference: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; SOX Section 302

description: The effective start date of the underlying commercial agreement generating this recurring revenue. Used to determine contract tenure, cohort analysis, and ARR vintage reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA SD; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

description: Current lifecycle state of the underlying commercial agreement contributing to this ARR entry. Drives inclusion/exclusion logic in ARR calculations and investor disclosures.
reference: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; SOX Section 302

description: The total duration of the underlying commercial agreement in years (e.g., 1.0, 2.5, 5.0). Used for ARR normalization on multi-year deals and for weighted average contract length (WACL) reporting in investor materials.
reference: SAP S/4HANA SD; FASB ASC 606; Workday Adaptive Planning

description: The total ARR value as explicitly stated in the signed commercial contract, before any adjustments for churn, expansion, or discounts. Used as the baseline for variance analysis against recognized ARR and for multi-year deal tracking.
reference: SAP S/4HANA SD; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

description: The ARR reduction during the reporting period due to downgrades, seat reductions, or renegotiated contract terms for existing subscribers or partners, without full cancellation. Distinct from churn_amount which represents full cancellations.
reference: SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302; Salesforce CRM

description: The timestamp when this ARR tracker record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX Section 302/404 and data lineage tracking for financial reporting.
reference: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; ISO 20121

description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this ARR record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency ARR reporting for global markets including international broadcast rights and overseas sponsorship deals.
reference: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SEC Financial Reporting

description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this ARR entry was sourced (e.g., SAP S/4HANA for broadcast rights, Salesforce CRM for sponsorship contracts, Adobe Experience Platform for OTT subscriptions). Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
reference: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Salesforce CRM

description: The total contractual discount applied to the recurring revenue for this period, reducing the billed amount from the list price. Used in revenue quality analysis and margin reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA SD; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

description: The commercial channel through which this recurring revenue is generated. Enables ARR waterfall analysis by channel (DTC OTT vs RSN broadcast vs season ticket vs sponsorship) for investor and board reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dtc_ott|rsn_broadcast|season_ticket|corporate_sponsorship|licensing — promote to reference product]
reference: SAP S/4HANA SD; Workday Adaptive Planning; SEC Financial Reporting

description: The incremental ARR gained during the reporting period from upsells, upgrades, seat additions, or contract amendments for existing subscribers or partners. Drives net revenue retention (NRR) calculations in investor reporting.
reference: SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302; Salesforce CRM

description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the primary geographic market for this recurring revenue stream. Supports regional ARR segmentation for international broadcast rights, OTT DTC markets, and global sponsorship reporting.
reference: ISO 3166-1; SEC Financial Reporting; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

business_glossary_term: List Price Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) Amount
description: The undiscounted ARR value at standard list pricing before any contractual discounts, promotional credits, or negotiated reductions. Used for discount rate analysis and pricing strategy reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA SD; Workday Adaptive Planning; FASB ASC 606

description: The normalized monthly recurring revenue amount for this contract or subscription in the reporting period currency. MRR is the foundational metric for subscription business health, used in ARPU calculations and investor KPI dashboards. Excludes one-time fees and variable usage charges.
reference: SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302; Workday Adaptive Planning

description: Indicates whether this ARR entry is derived from a multi-year contract (e.g., a 3-year broadcast rights agreement or 5-year naming rights sponsorship). Multi-year deals require special ARR normalization and disclosure treatment in SEC filings.
reference: FASB ASC 606; SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302

description: The net change in ARR for this record during the reporting period, calculated as new ARR + expansion ARR − churn ARR − contraction ARR. The primary waterfall metric for ARR bridge reporting in board and investor presentations.
reference: SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302; Workday Adaptive Planning

description: The number of net-new subscribers or partners added during the reporting period for this ARR component type. Used in subscriber acquisition analysis and CAC/LTV modeling.
reference: Adobe Experience Platform; Salesforce CRM; SEC Financial Reporting

description: The subscription or partnership tier level for this recurring revenue entry (e.g., Basic OTT, Premium OTT, VIP Season Membership, Enterprise Sponsorship). Used for ARPU segmentation and upsell/expansion analysis.
reference: Salesforce CRM; Adobe Experience Platform; Workday Adaptive Planning

description: The estimated probability (0.00–100.00) that this contract or subscription will renew at expiry, as assessed by the commercial or FP&A team. Used in ARR forecasting, at-risk ARR identification, and Workday Adaptive Planning pipeline models.
reference: Workday Adaptive Planning; Salesforce CRM; SEC Financial Reporting

description: The last day of the fiscal reporting period to which this ARR snapshot applies. Paired with reporting_period_start to define the measurement window for ARR, MRR, churn, and expansion calculations.
reference: SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 606

description: The first day of the fiscal reporting period (month or quarter) to which this ARR snapshot applies. Used to align ARR metrics with SEC quarterly and annual financial disclosures.
reference: SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 606

description: The ASC 606-compliant method used to recognize revenue from this recurring stream over the contract term. Distinct from the commercial ARR metric — this field links the ARR tracker to the revenue_recognition_schedule product for accounting treatment alignment.
reference: FASB ASC 606; SEC Financial Reporting; SOX Section 302

description: Indicates whether this ARR record is subject to SOX internal control review as part of the financial reporting control environment for publicly traded entities. Flagged records require additional audit trail documentation and management sign-off.
reference: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

description: The number of active subscribers, season ticket holders, or contracted partners contributing to this ARR entry at the end of the reporting period. Used to compute ARPU and track subscriber base growth for investor KPIs.
reference: SEC Financial Reporting; Adobe Experience Platform; Workday Adaptive Planning

description: The timestamp of the most recent update to this ARR tracker record. Used for change data capture, audit trail compliance under SOX, and incremental Silver Layer processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
reference: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue recognition schedules post recognized revenue to a specific GL account. The gl_account_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK recognized_gl_account_id → gl_account.gl_account_id.
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: The revenue recognition accounting standard applied to this schedule. ASC_606 for US GAAP entities; IFRS_15 for international entities; ASC_606_IFRS_15 for dual-reporting entities. Determines the specific recognition criteria and disclosure requirements.
reference: ASC 606 (FASB), IFRS 15 (IASB), SEC Regulation S-X

description: Indicates whether the variable consideration constraint has been applied to limit the recognized amount to the extent it is highly probable (IFRS 15) or probable (ASC 606) that a significant revenue reversal will not occur. Required for ASC 606 / IFRS 15 compliance documentation.
reference: ASC 606 Step 3 — Constraining Estimates, IFRS 15.56–15.58

description: The date the underlying contract became legally binding and enforceable. Used as the ASC 606 contract inception date for determining transaction price and allocating to performance obligations.
reference: ASC 606 Step 1, IFRS 15.9, SAP S/4HANA SD

description: The date the underlying contract expires or terminates. For multi-year broadcast rights or naming rights agreements, this may be several years in the future. Nullable for evergreen contracts.
reference: ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA SD

description: Classification of the underlying revenue contract driving this recognition schedule. Determines applicable recognition methodology and disclosure requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast_rights|sponsorship|naming_rights|season_ticket|multi_event|licensing|merchandise|ppv|ott_subscription|nil_agreement — promote to reference product]
reference: ASC 606 Step 1, IFRS 15, SEC Regulation S-X

description: Timestamp when this revenue recognition schedule record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation point required for SOX compliance and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
reference: SOX Section 404, SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Trail

description: Total revenue recognized to date against this performance obligation since the recognition start date. Equals total_contract_value minus deferred_revenue_balance at any point in time. Used for period-end reconciliation and ASC 606 cumulative catch-up adjustment calculations.
reference: ASC 606, IFRS 15.B1, SAP S/4HANA RAR

description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this recognition schedule (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency broadcast rights and international sponsorship contracts.
reference: ISO 4217, IFRS 15, ASC 606

description: Revenue amount to be recognized in the current accounting period for this performance obligation. Drives the period-end journal entry generation in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO. For straight-line method, equals total_contract_value divided by total periods; for milestone/event-based, equals the value of the milestone achieved.
reference: ASC 606 Step 5, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI Journal Entry

description: Current outstanding deferred revenue balance for this performance obligation — the portion of total contract value received or billed but not yet recognized as earned revenue. Drives the deferred revenue waterfall report and balance sheet liability disclosure. Updated each period-end close in SAP S/4HANA FI.
reference: ASC 606, IFRS 15, SEC Regulation S-X, SAP S/4HANA FI

business_glossary_term: Deferred Revenue General Ledger (GL) Account Code
description: SAP S/4HANA GL account code for the deferred revenue liability balance sheet account. The deferred revenue balance is carried here until recognized. Required for balance sheet reporting and SOX-compliant financial controls.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts, ASC 606, SOX Section 404, SEC Regulation S-X

description: The discount rate (as a decimal, e.g., 0.0450 for 4.50%) used to adjust for the significant financing component in the transaction price. Reflects the rate that would be used in a separate financing transaction between the entity and the counterparty at contract inception. Null when significant_financing_flag is false.
reference: ASC 606-10-32-15, IFRS 15.64, SAP S/4HANA RAR

description: The date of the most recent revenue recognition posting for this performance obligation. Used to confirm period-end close completion and to identify schedules that have not been processed in the current period.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI, ASC 606, SOX

description: The effective date of the most recent contract modification affecting this recognition schedule. Null when modification_flag is false. Used to determine the prospective or cumulative catch-up adjustment period.
reference: ASC 606-10-25-12, IFRS 15.18, SAP S/4HANA SD

description: Indicates whether this recognition schedule reflects a contract modification (e.g., renegotiated broadcast rights fee, amended sponsorship scope). When true, the modification accounting treatment (prospective or cumulative catch-up) per ASC 606-10-25-12 / IFRS 15.18 must be documented.

The scheduled date for the next revenue recognition posting. Used by the FP&A team in Workday Adaptive Planning for revenue forecasting and by the accounting team to manage period-end close calendars.
reference: Workday Adaptive Planning, SAP S/4HANA RAR, ASC 606

description: Narrative description of the distinct performance obligation being recognized, as documented in the contract and required for ASC 606 / IFRS 15 disclosure. Examples: 'Exclusive broadcast rights for NFL regular season games FY2024-FY2026', 'Naming rights for stadium facade and digital signage', 'Season ticket package — 41 home games'.
reference: ASC 606 Step 2, IFRS 15.22, SEC Regulation S-K

description: Number of accounting periods for which revenue has been recognized to date against this performance obligation. Used to track progress toward full recognition and to validate cumulative_recognized_amount in period-end reconciliation.
reference: ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA RAR

description: Indicates whether revenue is recognized over time (e.g., broadcast rights delivered continuously over a season) or at a point in time (e.g., a one-time PPV event, a single concert). Fundamental ASC 606 / IFRS 15 classification that determines the recognition pattern.
reference: ASC 606 Step 5, IFRS 15.31–15.38

description: The date on which revenue recognition is expected to be fully completed for this performance obligation. For multi-year broadcast rights, this may span several fiscal years. Nullable for open-ended or usage-based obligations without a fixed end date.
reference: ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA RAR

description: The accounting method used to recognize revenue over the performance obligation period. Straight-line = equal amounts per period; Milestone = upon achievement of defined deliverables; Usage-based = proportional to actual consumption (e.g., broadcast impressions, CPM); Event-based = upon occurrence of specific events (e.g., game played); Proportional performance = based on percentage of obligation fulfilled.
reference: ASC 606 Step 5 — Recognize Revenue, IFRS 15.39–15.45

description: The date on which revenue recognition commences for this performance obligation. Typically aligns with contract effective date or the date the entity begins satisfying the performance obligation (e.g., first broadcast date, season opener, naming rights activation).
reference: ASC 606, IFRS 15.31, SAP S/4HANA RAR

description: Current lifecycle state of the revenue recognition schedule. Draft = under review; Active = currently recognizing revenue; Suspended = temporarily halted (e.g., contract dispute); Completed = fully recognized; Cancelled = contract terminated before full recognition.
reference: ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA RAR

description: Externally-visible business identifier for this recognition schedule, formatted as RRS-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. Used in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO journal entry references, audit workpapers, and SEC financial reporting disclosures.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), ASC 606

description: Indicates whether the contract contains a significant financing component requiring adjustment of the transaction price for the time value of money per ASC 606-10-32-15 / IFRS 15.60. Common in multi-year prepaid broadcast rights deals where cash is received significantly in advance of performance.

The total transaction price allocated to this performance obligation as determined at contract inception per ASC 606 Step 3 (Determine Transaction Price) and Step 4 (Allocate Transaction Price). Expressed in the contract currency. Used as the basis for deferred revenue waterfall reporting.
reference: ASC 606 Steps 3–4, IFRS 15.73–15.86, SAP S/4HANA RAR

description: Total number of accounting periods over which revenue is to be recognized for this performance obligation. Used for straight-line recognition calculations and deferred revenue waterfall projections. For event-based recognition, represents the total number of qualifying events.
reference: ASC 606, IFRS 15, Workday Adaptive Planning FP&A

description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this revenue recognition schedule record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for change data capture in the Databricks Silver Layer and SOX audit trail completeness.
reference: SOX Section 404, SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Trail, Databricks Delta Lake

description: The estimated amount of variable consideration included in the transaction price at the most likely amount or expected value method per ASC 606. Applicable for contracts with performance bonuses, ratings escalators, or PPV revenue share components. Null when variable_consideration_flag is false.
reference: ASC 606 Step 3, IFRS 15.53, SAP S/4HANA RAR

description: Indicates whether the transaction price includes variable consideration components (e.g., performance bonuses, ratings-based escalators, PPV revenue share, usage-based royalties). When true, the constraint on variable consideration per ASC 606 Step 3 must be applied and reassessed each reporting period.
reference: ASC 606 Step 3 — Variable Consideration, IFRS 15.50–15.59

description: Unique surrogate identifier for each revenue stream classification record in the Sports Entertainment enterprise. Primary key for the finance.revenue_stream master data product.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Revenue Category Master

description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Revenue streams are scoped to a specific legal entity for SEC reporting and intercompany elimination. The company_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to company_code.company_code_id.
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue streams are mapped to specific GL accounts in the chart of accounts for financial reporting. The gl_account_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to gl_account.gl_account_id.
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Foreign key linking to legal.ip_portfolio. Business justification: Revenue streams in Sports Entertainment (broadcast rights fees, trademark licensing, content syndication) are directly generated by specific IP assets. Linking revenue_stream to ip_portfolio enables I
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Employee identifier of the business owner accountable for this revenue stream's performance, budget attainment, and SOX control compliance. Typically a VP or Director of Finance, Revenue, or the relevant business unit. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors HCM.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors HCM; SOX Section 302 Management Certification

description: Self-referencing FK on revenue_stream (parent_revenue_stream_id)

Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Revenue streams are attributed to profit centers (e.g., broadcast rights revenue → broadcast profit center). The profit_center_code string field should be replaced with a typed FK to profit_center.pro
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Approved annual revenue budget for this stream in the stream's transactional currency, sourced from Workday Adaptive Planning FP&A models. Used as the baseline for variance analysis, EBITDA forecasting, and board-level revenue target reporting.
reference: Workday Adaptive Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Planning; SOX Section 302

description: Board-approved year-over-year revenue growth target for this stream expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.1200 = 12.00%). Used in FP&A scenario modeling, investor relations KPI reporting, and ARR growth tracking for subscription-based streams.
reference: Workday Adaptive Planning; SEC MD&A Disclosure; ARR Growth Benchmarks

description: Indicates whether this revenue stream contributes to the enterprise's Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) metric tracked for investor reporting and subscription business health. True for OTT subscriptions, DTC memberships, multi-year sponsorship contracts, and naming rights deals with fixed annual payments.
reference: ARR Reporting Standards; SEC MD&A Disclosure; Workday Adaptive Planning ARR Module

description: Indicates whether Cost Per Mille (CPM) pricing methodology applies to this revenue stream. True for broadcast advertising inventory, digital display sponsorships, and OTT pre-roll ad placements where revenue is calculated on a per-thousand-impressions basis. Drives ad inventory valuation in broadcast ad placement workflows.
reference: IAB CPM Advertising Standards; FCC Broadcast Advertising Regulation; Dalet Galaxy Ad Inventory

description: Timestamp when this revenue stream master record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation event required for SOX internal controls documentation and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
reference: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 8601

description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the primary transactional currency of this revenue stream (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD). Used for FX translation to group reporting currency in SAP S/4HANA and Workday Adaptive Planning consolidation.
reference: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

description: Indicates whether Digital Rights Management (DRM) controls apply to the content or media assets generating this revenue stream. True for OTT, PPV, IPTV, and broadcast rights streams where content protection is mandated by rights agreements. Triggers DRM policy enforcement in Dalet Galaxy and CDN configurations.
reference: Dalet Galaxy DRM Policy; FCC Broadcast Regulation; WIPO Copyright Treaty

business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Contribution Flag
description: Indicates whether this revenue stream is included in the enterprise EBITDA calculation reported to investors, lenders, and the SEC. False for pass-through revenue streams (e.g., league revenue sharing remittances) that are excluded from EBITDA by accounting policy.
reference: SEC Non-GAAP Financial Measures Guidance; EBITDA Reporting Standards; SOX Section 302

description: Date from which this revenue stream classification record is valid and active for financial posting and reporting. Supports time-variant master data management in SAP S/4HANA and enables historical revenue stream analysis across fiscal periods.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Time Dependency; ASC 606 Contract Effective Date

description: Date on which this revenue stream classification record expires or is superseded. Null for open-ended streams. Used in SAP S/4HANA time-dependent master data management and to enforce revenue stream sunset dates aligned with contract expirations or league restructuring.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Time Dependency; ASC 606 Contract Term

description: The fiscal year to which this revenue stream budget and growth targets apply, aligned to the company's SAP S/4HANA fiscal year variant. Enables period-specific revenue planning, variance reporting, and multi-year trend analysis.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; Workday Adaptive Planning

description: Primary geographic market for this revenue stream expressed as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN, AUS). Drives GDPR/CCPA compliance scoping, tax jurisdiction assignment, currency hedging strategy, and international broadcast rights window management.
reference: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; CCPA; FCC Broadcast Regulation

description: Indicates whether this revenue stream involves intercompany transactions between legal entities within the Sports Entertainment group (e.g., broadcast rights fees from a subsidiary RSN to the parent league entity). Triggers intercompany elimination in consolidated financial statements and SAP S/4HANA intercompany settlement workflows.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany Accounting; ASC 810 Consolidation; SEC Consolidated Reporting

description: Classification of the IP rights position underlying this revenue stream. 'owned' applies to proprietary league marks and team IP; 'licensed_out' applies to broadcast rights deals and merchandise licensing; 'licensed_in' applies to third-party content distribution; 'shared' applies to co-branded sponsorship activations. Drives DRM policy assignment and IP royalty accounting.
reference: IP Rights Management Framework; DRM Policy Standards; FIFA/NFL/NBA IP Licensing Rules

description: Identifier for the sports league or governing body associated with this revenue stream (e.g., NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, FIFA, UFC, ATP). Enables league-level revenue segmentation for CBA compliance reporting, league office revenue sharing calculations, and governing body regulatory filings.
reference: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS/FIFA/UFC/ATP League Governance; CBA Revenue Sharing Rules

description: Indicates whether this revenue stream involves payment card transactions subject to PCI-DSS compliance requirements. True for ticketing (Ticketmaster/AXS), merchandise e-commerce (Shopify Plus), and venue POS transactions. Triggers PCI-DSS control requirements and quarterly compliance attestation.
reference: PCI DSS v4.0; PCI SSC Standards; Ticketmaster/AXS Payment Processing

description: Calendar date on which the primary revenue-generating season concludes for this stream (e.g., Super Bowl, NBA Finals, World Series). Paired with peak_season_start_date to define the active revenue window for seasonal cash flow modeling.
reference: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Official Season Calendars; ISO 20121 Event Management

description: Calendar date on which the primary revenue-generating season begins for this stream (e.g., NFL regular season kickoff, NBA opening night, concert tour launch). Used in cash flow forecasting, staffing plans, and venue operations scheduling.
reference: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/MLS Official Season Calendars; ISO 20121 Event Management

description: Audited actual revenue recognized for this stream in the immediately preceding fiscal year, in the stream's transactional currency. Serves as the comparative baseline for SEC annual report (10-K) year-over-year revenue disclosures and EBITDA bridge analysis.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Actual Postings; SEC 10-K Annual Report; SOX Section 404

description: Numeric level of this revenue stream within the enterprise revenue reporting hierarchy (1 = top-level category, 2 = subcategory, 3 = detailed stream). Enables hierarchical roll-up in FP&A dashboards, EBITDA waterfall charts, and SEC segment disclosures.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Hierarchy; Workday Adaptive Planning Hierarchy

description: ASC 606 / IFRS 15 revenue recognition method applied to this stream. 'point_in_time' for single-event ticket sales; 'over_time' for multi-year broadcast rights deals and season sponsorships; 'usage_based' for PPV and gaming; 'milestone' for performance-based NIL agreements; 'ratable' for subscription OTT/DTC services.
reference: ASC 606 (Revenue from Contracts with Customers); IFRS 15; SOX Section 404

description: Indicates whether this revenue stream is subject to league-mandated revenue sharing obligations under the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) or league constitution (e.g., NFL national media revenue pool, NBA Basketball Related Income sharing). Triggers intercompany settlement workflows in SAP S/4HANA.
reference: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL CBA Revenue Sharing Provisions; SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Settlement

description: The contractually mandated percentage of gross revenue from this stream that must be shared with the league office or other member clubs under the applicable CBA or revenue sharing agreement (e.g., 0.3400 = 34.00% of national broadcast revenue to league pool). Null when revenue_sharing_flag is False.
reference: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL CBA Revenue Sharing Provisions; CAS Arbitration Standards

description: Current lifecycle state of the revenue stream master record. 'active' streams are live and generating revenue; 'pending' are approved but not yet launched; 'seasonal' are active only during defined event seasons; 'discontinued' are retired streams retained for historical reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Lifecycle; SOX Control Framework

description: Describes the temporal revenue generation pattern for this stream. 'in_season' applies to gate receipts and broadcast rights tied to league calendars; 'event_driven' applies to PPV, concerts, and one-off events; 'year_round' applies to OTT subscriptions and naming rights; 'quarterly'/'monthly' applies to ratable sponsorship and licensing fees.
reference: Workday Adaptive Planning Seasonal Modeling; NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL Season Calendars

description: Operating segment identifier for this revenue stream as defined under ASC 280 / IFRS 8 segment reporting requirements. Maps to the reportable segments disclosed in SEC filings (e.g., 'Live Events', 'Media & Broadcasting', 'Consumer Products', 'Digital & Gaming'). Enables segment-level P&L reporting.
reference: ASC 280 Segment Reporting; IFRS 8; SEC 10-K Segment Disclosures

description: Operational system of record from which this revenue stream master record originates. Enables data lineage tracking, reconciliation between source systems, and Silver Layer provenance documentation. SAP_S4HANA is the primary SSOT for financial master data.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Workday Adaptive Planning; Databricks Data Lineage Standards

description: Indicates whether this revenue stream is within scope for SOX Section 302/404 internal controls over financial reporting. True for all material revenue streams contributing to SEC-reported financials. Triggers mandatory SOX control testing, documentation, and sign-off workflows.
reference: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; SEC Financial Reporting Requirements

description: The SAP FI clearing document number (AUGBL) generated when this payment clears one or more open items in the AR or AP subledger. Used for cash application matching and open item management in the general ledger.

description: The externally-known SAP FI payment document number assigned at the time of posting. Serves as the primary business identifier for the payment transaction used in reconciliation, audit trails, and SOX financial controls. Corresponds to BELNR in SAP BKPF.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Document (BKPF.BELNR); SOX Section 404

description: The contractual due date by which the payment obligation must be settled per invoice payment terms. Used for early payment discount eligibility, late payment penalty calculation, and days-payable-outstanding (DPO) / days-sales-outstanding (DSO) analytics.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Net Due Date (BSEG.FAEDT); GAAP ASC 310

description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the company code local currency (typically USD) at the time of payment posting. Sourced from SAP FI exchange rate tables (TCURR). Critical for multi-currency reconciliation and FX gain/loss reporting.

description: The total gross amount of the payment before any deductions, discounts, or withholding taxes. Expressed in the transaction currency. Forms the basis for EBITDA reporting and revenue recognition in SAP FI. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this transaction.

description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this payment record, including status changes, reversals, or data corrections. Required for SOX audit trail, change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse pipeline, and GDPR accountability.
reference: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2); SAP S/4HANA FI Change Documents

description: The payment amount converted to the company code local currency (USD) using the exchange_rate at posting date. Used for consolidated financial reporting, SEC filings, and EBITDA calculations in the functional currency.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Local Currency Amount (BSEG.DMBTR); IFRS 21; SEC Regulation S-X

description: The net amount actually transferred after deducting cash discounts and withholding taxes from the gross amount (gross_amount - discount_amount - withholding_tax_amount). Represents the actual cash movement for treasury and bank reconciliation. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Net Amount; IAS 7; GAAP ASC 230

description: The principal business event date on which the payment was executed or value-dated by the bank. Used for cash flow reporting, aging analysis, and period-end close. Corresponds to ZFBDT (baseline date) or VALUT (value date) in SAP FI. Distinct from the document posting date.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Date (BSEG.ZFBDT); IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to execute the payment. ACH = Automated Clearing House electronic transfer; wire = bank wire transfer (SWIFT/SEPA); check = paper or electronic check; card = credit/debit card (PCI-DSS governed); digital_wallet = PayPal, Apple Pay, or similar; direct_debit = pre-authorized bank debit. Drives bank file format selection in SAP F110.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Method (BSEG.ZLSCH); PCI-DSS v4.0; NACHA ACH Rules

description: Current lifecycle state of the payment transaction within the SAP FI workflow. 'initiated' = payment instruction created; 'posted' = document posted to general ledger; 'cleared' = open items cleared; 'reversed' = payment reversed with reversal document; 'failed' = bank rejection or processing error; 'on_hold' = payment blocked pending approval or dispute resolution.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Status; SOX Section 404

description: Business classification of the payment transaction purpose. vendor_disbursement = AP payment to supplier/contractor; customer_receipt = AR collection from ticket buyer, sponsor, or broadcaster; intercompany_settlement = payment between Sports Entertainment legal entities; payroll_disbursement = athlete or staff salary payment; tax_payment = remittance to tax authority; refund = return of funds to customer. description: The accounting period posting date on which the payment document was recorded in the SAP FI general ledger. Determines the fiscal period for revenue recognition and financial reporting. May differ from payment_date for cross-period transactions.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date (BKPF.BUDAT); GAAP ASC 230; IAS 7

description: The SAP CO profit center (PRCTR) to which this payment is attributed for segment-level P&L reporting. Enables EBITDA analysis by business unit (e.g., NFL franchise, concert division, OTT streaming, venue operations) as required for SEC segment reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center (CEPC.PRCTR); SEC Regulation S-X Segment Reporting; IFRS 8

description: Indicates whether a remittance advice notification has been sent to the payee or payer detailing the invoices cleared by this payment. Supports vendor and customer communication workflows in SAP FI output management.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Output Management; NACHA Remittance Advice

description: The SAP FI document number of the reversal posting if this payment has been reversed (e.g., returned ACH, stopped check, duplicate payment correction). Null if the payment has not been reversed. Links to the reversing document for audit trail.

description: SAP FI reversal reason code (STGRD) explaining why the payment was reversed (e.g., wrong amount, duplicate, bank return, stop payment). Null if not reversed. Used for exception reporting and fraud detection analytics.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Reason (T041T); SOX Section 404

description: SAP FI special GL indicator (UMSKZ) classifying non-standard postings such as down payments, guarantees, or security deposits associated with this payment. Blank for standard payment postings. Used for balance sheet sub-classification.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Special GL Transactions (BSEG.UMSKZ); GAAP ASC 210

description: The SWIFT end-to-end transaction reference (UETR or TRN) for wire transfer payments. Enables real-time payment tracking via SWIFT gpi and bank confirmation matching. Null for non-wire payment methods.
reference: SWIFT MT103/MX pacs.008; SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Communication Management

description: The SAP FI payment terms key (ZTERM) governing the due date calculation and early payment discount conditions for this transaction (e.g., NT30, 2/10NET30). Inherited from the invoice or vendor/customer master. Drives DSO and DPO analytics.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms (T052.ZTERM); GAAP ASC 310

description: The amount of withholding tax deducted from the payment at source, applicable to athlete NIL payments, foreign vendor disbursements, and royalty settlements. Reported to tax authorities and reflected in SAP FI withholding tax tables (WITH_ITEM).
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Withholding Tax (WITH_ITEM); IRS Form 1099/1042-S; GDPR; SOX

The precise date and time when the payment run execution finished, whether successfully or with errors. Used to calculate processing duration and SLA compliance.
The date and time when the payment run record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.
The total cash discount amount taken across all payments in this run for early payment. Represents savings achieved through prompt payment programs.

Boolean flag indicating whether this payment run is a reversal of a previous run. True indicates reversal, false indicates original payment run.
